structural_reconstructibility.reason: The shared writer is queried-verified-normal-only; nonquery, queried defect, writer-rejected and no-content-change events do not add prototype content. Iterate event metadata for exact before/after checks, but regenerate features/maps only for queried positions required by the original writer/anchor protocol.
structural_reconstructibility.full_stream_rerun_rule: Do not rerun the backbone unless a separately authorized query-only replay first has an exact-parity failure that demonstrates missing nonquery feature computation is necessary. Stop the affected trajectory on any mismatch.

required_exact_comparisons: memory content version before and after every event
memory SHA-256 before and after every event
source-map digest/revision and writer source attribution where recorded
stored C64 q90 and transport identity before and after every event
regenerated queried-event M0 scalar score equals the saved static score tape

replay_implementation.input_access_order: authorization validation, event metadata, queried image feature, queried-event static map and scalar parity, queried label disclosure, writer, post-state/C64 comparison
replay_implementation.failure_behavior: Raise exact mismatch at the affected position and stop; no correction, approximation, retry, or artifact overwrite.
